## Create Full Products Seamlessly with AntWorks

AntWorks simplifies product development by combining AI and human skills. Our “ant” engineers handle
all stages, from start to finish, making the process quicker, more affordable, and delivering great
results that boost your business.

[dashboard screenshot with dials and graphs.]

## How it works

### Build anything in 4 easy steps.
1. 1
   
   **Chat Interface:**
   Talk to AntWorks just like you're chatting with a real engineer. Just type your ideas or tasks,
   and our platform gets to work.
2. 2
   
   **AntWorks creates a project plan for you:**
   For larger software projects, our AI-powered platform creates a project outline with tasks and
   progress indicators.
3. 3
   
   **Microtasks:**
   AntWorks breaks down projects into small, easy-to-handle tasks called microtasks. Because these
   tasks are so small, they're easy to complete and approve.
4. 4
   
   **Review and Approve:**
   Check the tasks as they're done. If you like what you see, approve them. You only pay for tasks
   you're happy with.

## Pricing

### Choose the plan that works for you

Each microtask costs 1 to 10 credits based on its complexity. A task could be a small app feature, a
website page, or a technical job like a unit test. We think a human engineer needs about 1 hour for
a 10-credit task. You only pay for tasks you like.

### Starter

Pay-as-you-go pricing

$0.99 per credit
[Request Access][5]
* Unlimited projects
* AI-assisted project management
* Basic customer support

### Pro

For growing teams

$999 per month
[Request Access][6]
* 1,000 credits per month
* Priority task execution
* Dedicated capacity for your project
* Premium customer support

### Enterprise

# Global Automation Solutions Provider

## Delivering an Automated Advantage for Our Customers 

Brooks is a global leader of automation and contamination control solutions that are a critical
foundation to the AI-enabled world within the semiconductor and life science markets.

## Why Brooks

### Innovation That Enables AI and Powers the Modern World

Semiconductors power the AI revolution. Brooks’ innovation is at the heart of enabling the future of
semiconductors.

Brooks is a strategic partner to leading equipment manufacturers and semiconductor fabs across the
globe. We provide our customers an automated advantage by delivering innovation that exceeds
critical performance and lowers cost of ownership.

Brooks has over 100,000 automation solutions that continually operate around-the-clock within
mission-critical semiconductor and advanced packaging fabs. Brooks’ solutions are foundational in
manufacturing the majority of electronics around the world.

[Why Brooks][28]

## Our Story

### Proven Capabilities That Solve Our Customers’ High-Value Problems

From our beginning in 1978, our founders Norman and Frank Brooks outlined a vision for creating
value in the semiconductor manufacturing industry by applying innovative technology, system
expertise, and close customer partnerships to deliver automated solutions, transforming the
productivity of semiconductor fabrication.

Our team of over 2,000 employees across the globe is at the heart everything we do. We invest in our
customers, employees, communities, partners, and have a solid track record with our investors. These
investments have developed proven capability that is the foundation of providing our customers an
automated advantage.

Our deep knowledge and close collaboration with our customers enables reliable, mission-critical
solutions to their complex, high-value problems.

### Deep Knowledge to Solve Your Complex Challenges

# Global Automation Solutions Provider

## Delivering an Automated Advantage for Our Customers 

Brooks is a global leader of automation and contamination control solutions that are a critical
foundation to the AI-enabled world within the semiconductor and life science markets.

## Why Brooks

### Innovation That Enables AI and Powers the Modern World

Semiconductors power the AI revolution. Brooks’ innovation is at the heart of enabling the future of
semiconductors.

Brooks is a strategic partner to leading equipment manufacturers and semiconductor fabs across the
globe. We provide our customers an automated advantage by delivering innovation that exceeds
critical performance and lowers cost of ownership.

Brooks has over 100,000 automation solutions that continually operate around-the-clock within
mission-critical semiconductor and advanced packaging fabs. Brooks’ solutions are foundational in
manufacturing the majority of electronics around the world.

[Why Brooks][28]

## Our Story

### Proven Capabilities That Solve Our Customers’ High-Value Problems

From our beginning in 1978, our founders Norman and Frank Brooks outlined a vision for creating
value in the semiconductor manufacturing industry by applying innovative technology, system
expertise, and close customer partnerships to deliver automated solutions, transforming the
productivity of semiconductor fabrication.

Our team of over 2,000 employees across the globe is at the heart everything we do. We invest in our
customers, employees, communities, partners, and have a solid track record with our investors. These
investments have developed proven capability that is the foundation of providing our customers an
automated advantage.

Our deep knowledge and close collaboration with our customers enables reliable, mission-critical
solutions to their complex, high-value problems.

### Deep Knowledge to Solve Your Complex Challenges

Automation and contamination expertise across mechatronics, material science, thermodynamics,
vision, and surface engineering to solve the most complex engineering challenges.

### Global Operational Excellence From Start to Scale

When our customers are innovating and need tools, we deliver proven solutions to meet their
timeframe. When it’s time to ramp up, we’re ready anywhere across the globe.

### Responsive Lifecycle Service Close to You

We enable uninterrupted, 24/7 semiconductor manufacturing operations with expert service, training,
and support wherever our customers are.

[About Brooks][29]

Brooks partnered with us to innovate an automated solution that gave us an advantage in changing
cost of ownership and time to market as we developed a new platform to implement our leading-edge
process technology required for next generation AI semiconductors.

As we developed new advanced technology for devices, we discovered new contaminants were lowering
our yield. Brooks was instrumental in early understanding and identification of the problem and
quickly delivered a measurement and cleaning solution to ensure risk was mitigated before launching
the advanced technology.

## Do you work with buildings at any stage, from design to demolition?

We use our deep understanding of the building lifecycle to help you implement Artificial
Intelligence (AI) effectively.

 

We guide you past experimentation to real-world application. Our approaches focuses on aligning AI
with your specific building-related goals, integrating it smoothly with your tools, and ensuring
your team can use it.

 

We transform your teams workflows to make them more efficient, deliver clear benefits, and ensure
sustained performance.

[Architect at Work]

01

### Customized Approach

We don't just offer solutions; we prove them first. Our approach starts with Proof of Concepts
(PoCs) for AI-enabled solutions. Once proven, we scale these approaches using Microsoft Azure AI and
related platforms to ensure maximum impact and efficiency.

02

### Proven Success

We have a track record of delivering award-winning solutions to our clients. Our innovative approach
and dedication to excellence have been recognized by industry experts. Partner with us and
experience the difference of working with a trusted leader in the field.

03

### Expert Team

We have a team of highly skilled professionals who are dedicated to providing accurate and honest
services. With their expertise, we ensure that our clients receive the best solutions tailored to
their specific needs.

interiro design

Cognitive AI Enabled Architecture and Interior Design

Step into the future of architectural design, where the blueprint of success is drawn not just by
human hands, but assisted by the sharp, unerring precision of Cognitive Artificial Intelligence.


Imagine a world where design development is enhanced by AI agents, armed with the wisdom of
countless projects. They're not just problem solvers, they're problem anticipators, crafting designs
that are the epitome of efficiency and effectiveness.


Now, picture a project manager that never sleeps, never tires, and never misses a beat. These AI
agents are the tireless sentinels of your project, predicting delays, suggesting the perfect
allocation of resources, and keeping you updated every step of the way.


In a world where the future is green, our AI agents are the vanguard of sustainability. They
scrutinize every watt, every joule of energy, and find ways to trim the fat, making your buildings
lean, mean, green machines.

 

Space - the final frontier. But with our AI agents, you won't need a starship to conquer it. They'll
analyze every inch of your building, optimizing it to the hilt. Whether it's a shuffle of the
furniture or a change in layout, they'll find the solution that fits just right.


At the end of the day, it's all about the people. Our AI agents understand that. They'll study
occupant behavior, gauge satisfaction, and suggest changes that turn your workplace from just
another building into a home away from home.


Welcome to the future of architectural design.

 

Welcome to a world where human creativity meets AI precision. Welcome to the next level.

## Create Full Products Seamlessly with AntWorks

AntWorks simplifies product development by combining AI and human skills. Our “ant” engineers handle
all stages, from start to finish, making the process quicker, more affordable, and delivering great
results that boost your business.

[dashboard screenshot with dials and graphs.]

## How it works

### Build anything in 4 easy steps.
1. 1
   
   **Chat Interface:**
   Talk to AntWorks just like you're chatting with a real engineer. Just type your ideas or tasks,
   and our platform gets to work.
2. 2
   
   **AntWorks creates a project plan for you:**
   For larger software projects, our AI-powered platform creates a project outline with tasks and
   progress indicators.
3. 3
   
   **Microtasks:**
   AntWorks breaks down projects into small, easy-to-handle tasks called microtasks. Because these
   tasks are so small, they're easy to complete and approve.
4. 4
   
   **Review and Approve:**
   Check the tasks as they're done. If you like what you see, approve them. You only pay for tasks
   you're happy with.

## Pricing

### Choose the plan that works for you

Each microtask costs 1 to 10 credits based on its complexity. A task could be a small app feature, a
website page, or a technical job like a unit test. We think a human engineer needs about 1 hour for
a 10-credit task. You only pay for tasks you like.

### Starter

Pay-as-you-go pricing

$0.99 per credit

* Unlimited projects
* AI-assisted project management
* Basic customer support

human hands, but assisted by the sharp, unerring precision of Cognitive Artificial Intelligence.

countless projects. They're not just problem solvers, they're problem anticipators, crafting designs

allocation of resources, and keeping you updated every step of the way.

scrutinize every watt, every joule of energy, and find ways to trim the fat, making your buildings
lean, mean, green machines.

 

Space - the final frontier. But with our AI agents, you won't need a starship to conquer it. They'll
analyze every inch of your building, optimizing it to the hilt. Whether it's a shuffle of the
furniture or a change in layout, they'll find the solution that fits just right.


At the end of the day, it's all about the people. Our AI agents understand that. They'll study
occupant behavior, gauge satisfaction, and suggest changes that turn your workplace from just
another building into a home away from home.


Welcome to the future of architectural design.

 

Welcome to a world where human creativity meets AI precision. Welcome to the next level.

## Document and email workflows break in four places. Your operations team feels it.

From intake to decision, the manual document workflow has four failure points. Each one is a tax on
your team and on your customer's experience.

Chasing documents
Extracting data
Cross-checking
Waiting on decisions
DOCUMENT INTAKE

### Your team spends more time chasing documents than processing them.

Inbound docs arrive across email, SFTP, drive folders, vendor portals, and scanned attachments. Half
are missing pages. The latest version is buried in a reply-all thread. Your team becomes the routing
layer copying attachments, classifying intent, asking "did you send the W-2?" for the third time.

Manual extraction

### Your team is reading PDFs and typing the data into systems.

Every invoice, application, claim, and form means someone opens a document, reads the fields, and
types them into NetSuite, Encompass, Epic, or your CRM. Slow. Expensive. Error-prone. The work
scales linearly with volume - your team doesn't.

Case validation

### Every case takes 20 minutes and a human to cross-check.

A loan packet, a claim, a KYC bundle. Each one needs someone to verify names match across three
documents, calculate the DTI, confirm income against the W-2, and check the reserves. The work is
rote, the volume is large, and one mistake costs the team a quarter.

Decision delivery

### Decisions sit in a queue while customers wait.

By the time a document gets routed, extracted, validated, and reviewed, days have passed. Your SLA
slipped. Your customer called twice. Your ops team is firefighting volume instead of improving the
process.

pipeline from any inbox or document source to your systems of record. Click any agent to see how it
works.

How it works

## Effortless document processing with ECIT Digital.

1. Import

Send any document through Email, API, E-Invoice, or as paper to one of our scanning locations.

2. Capture

Multiple machine learning models captures and classifies data from your document.

3. Validate

Our team validates the output from the capture process and correct mistakes eliminating need for
controlling data for you as customer.

4. Export

The system can export data to any API, SFTP, Email or similar in the format required by the
receiving system. Exports can be configured based on the content of documents, and ECIT Digital
supports integration to multiple systems in one document flow.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

## The operating system for smarter MSPs

MSPbots automates your entire operation, connects your whole tool stack, and gives you the
intelligence to make better decisions faster.

#### AI ticket triage

From 3 minutes to 3 seconds. Every ticket. Stop starting every morning with manual categorization.
MSPbots reads, classifies, and routes every incoming ticket instantly. It is trained on MSP-specific
language and works inside your existing PSA from day one.
‍

[Learn more][28]

#### AI ticket QA

AI Ticket QA automatically reviews every ticket against MSP industry best practices, helping you
measure service quality at scale. It identifies strengths, uncovers improvement opportunities, and
shows where your team stands on the path to operational maturity.

[Learn more][29]

#### NextTicket dispatch

The right ticket to the right tech. Automatically. End ticket cherry-picking and queue politics for
good. MSPbots routes every ticket based on skill, priority, and SLA. This ensures your dispatcher
focuses on judgment calls rather than day-to-day queue management.

[Learn more][30]

#### Sentiment analysis

Consistent service quality. Without the manual review. Catch issues before clients do. MSPbots
reviews ticket handling, flags gaps in resolution quality, and sends coaching nudges automatically —
so your standards stay high across every tech, every shift.

[Learn more][31]

#### Business intelligence

See it. Act on it. Automatically. One real-time dashboard pulling KPIs from 80+ integrations — SLA
tracking, technician utilization, ticket aging, and more. And when the numbers go off track,
automated bots fire instantly.
‍

[Learn more][32]

## Fundamentals of 24×7 Digital Worker Management

## Aggregation

[Radium AI Integration]

**Radium AI** collects bot-run details from multiple RPA instances and brings them to its central
repository for classification. It integrates with all the leading RPA platforms like UiPath,
Automation Anywhere (AA), and Blue Prism (BP). Data collected from various data sources enables
Radium AI to provide powerful analytics about bot operations.

Integrates with ITSM systems like ServiceNow to auto-generate tickets for all failures, minimizing
the need for 24×7 eyes on the glass.

## Classification

Powerful **ML Engine** analyzes the bot errors, identifies the root cause, and answers the two
fundamental questions of incident management:

## Automation built for the way MSPs do business

When manual processes slip, techs spin their wheels, budgets bleed on unused licenses, and clients
lose patience.

Rewst flips the equation. Built for the way MSPs operate, it combines native multi-tenancy, a
library of integrations and ready-to-use automations that we maintain for you, and RoboRewsty, an
in-platform AI assistant that guides you every step of the way.

The result: less busywork, faster ROI, more accurate workflows, and room to grow by increasing team
capacity. Employees get more breathing room to focus on higher-value work, which leads to faster
response times, fewer errors, and better service for clients.

Why Upmind?

## **Upmind isn’t just another billing tool**; it’s a complete business automation platform for
## subscription and service businesses. Instead of juggling multiple tools, manage everything from a
## **fast**, **scalable** & **readily** **customisable** panel. What more do you need?

## Upmind isn’t just another billing tool. It’s a complete business automation platform that makes
## running a service business a breeze. It’s fast, scalable & readily customisable. What more do you
## need?

## Imagine what you can do with a **powerhouse of features**.

It’s time to say goodbye to spreadsheets, endless invoices, and service bottlenecks, along with
those clunky, overpriced, self-hosted billing systems. Built as a complete SaaS-based solution that
is fast, reliable, and secure, Upmind is 'the' tool for ambitious businesses to automate their
everyday operations. Here’s how:

### All your clients in one place

Every account, every order, and every interaction is in one place, so you always know who your
clients are, what they need, and when to follow up. Custom fields, smart filtering, and built-in
automation keep everything running smoothly.

[

Explore client management

][22]

### Billing that runs itself

You don’t have to chase payments anymore. Upmind automates invoicing, renewals, reminders, global
tax calculations, and payment collection with custom invoice templates for businesses all over the
world, so all you do is get paid on time.

[

Explore billing automation

][23]

### Provisioning that 'just works'

The moment a customer places an order, Upmind automates service activation, provisioning, management
and payments to your billing system using powerful integrations—so services start, pause, or renew
exactly when they should.

[

Discover service provisioning

][24]

### An online store that’s ready-to-go

Whether you’re offering one-time purchases or recurring subscriptions, Upmind’s built-in online
store lets you customise pricing, run promotions, and deliver a smooth checkout experience—without
the need for extra eCommerce tools.

[

Explore the online store

][25]

### Service desk that simplifies support

Managing support tickets is no longer a headache. With Upmind’s built-in service desk, every ticket
is linked to the right client, product, and past interaction—so agents have all the context they
need, and clients get fast, efficient responses.

[

Discover service desk

][26]

## Document and email workflows break in four places. Your operations team feels it.

From intake to decision, the manual document workflow has four failure points. Each one is a tax on
your team and on your customer's experience.

Chasing documents
Extracting data
Cross-checking
Waiting on decisions
DOCUMENT INTAKE

### Your team spends more time chasing documents than processing them.

Inbound docs arrive across email, SFTP, drive folders, vendor portals, and scanned attachments. Half
are missing pages. The latest version is buried in a reply-all thread. Your team becomes the routing
layer copying attachments, classifying intent, asking "did you send the W-2?" for the third time.

Manual extraction

### Your team is reading PDFs and typing the data into systems.

Every invoice, application, claim, and form means someone opens a document, reads the fields, and
types them into NetSuite, Encompass, Epic, or your CRM. Slow. Expensive. Error-prone. The work
scales linearly with volume - your team doesn't.

Case validation

### Every case takes 20 minutes and a human to cross-check.

A loan packet, a claim, a KYC bundle. Each one needs someone to verify names match across three
documents, calculate the DTI, confirm income against the W-2, and check the reserves. The work is
rote, the volume is large, and one mistake costs the team a quarter.

Decision delivery

### Decisions sit in a queue while customers wait.

By the time a document gets routed, extracted, validated, and reviewed, days have passed. Your SLA
slipped. Your customer called twice. Your ops team is firefighting volume instead of improving the
process.

pipeline from any inbox or document source to your systems of record. Click any agent to see how it
works.

training, equipping, and empowering believers, leaders, and institutions to live out their prophetic

community development.

### How long does it take to build a Kaizen workflow?

Kaizen workflows operate deterministically, ensuring that your process is executed the exact same

### How can I trigger Kaizen workflows from my application?

Kaizen supports robust APIs and webhooks for creating logins, executing workflows, retrieving
execution results, and triaging work for human review.

### How does Kaizen handle 2FA for end-user logins?

We support 2FA in a number of ways:

• Email: Kaizen allows you to email 2FA codes to codes@mfa.kaizenautomation.com to automatically
complete logins for sites that require 2FA.
• TOTP (Authenticator app): Kaizen has a built-in authenticator, so you can upload a QR code or a
secret key to the Kaizen platform and Kaizen will automatically generate 2FA codes.
• SMS: We can handle SMS-based 2FA via API integration or through a Twilio integration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

All your automation questions, answered.

### How long does it take to build a Kaizen workflow?

Customers typically have their first workflow up and running in less than an hour.

### How reliable are Kaizen workflows?

Kaizen workflows operate deterministically, ensuring that your process is executed the exact same
way, every single time.

### How can I trigger Kaizen workflows from my application?

Kaizen supports robust APIs and webhooks for creating logins, executing workflows, retrieving
execution results, and triaging work for human review.

### How does Kaizen handle 2FA for end-user logins?

We support 2FA in a number of ways:

• Email: Kaizen allows you to email 2FA codes to codes@mfa.kaizenautomation.com to automatically
complete logins for sites that require 2FA.
• TOTP (Authenticator app): Kaizen has a built-in authenticator, so you can upload a QR code or a
secret key to the Kaizen platform and Kaizen will automatically generate 2FA codes.
• SMS: We can handle SMS-based 2FA via API integration or through a Twilio integration.

### Where do Kaizen workflows run?

After creating a Kaizen workflow, it runs on secure browsers in the cloud. This allows you to
infinitely scale your automations based on your desired volume.

### Do you cache individual browser actions?

All actions completed are cached as speed and reliability are core priorities for our customers.

### What is your pricing model?

Kaizen's pricing is simple, we charge on credits consumed each time a workflow is run.

# **Your AI initiative is only as good as the data feeding it.**

**Power your Gen-AI retrieval and results with clean structured data effortlessly transformed. **

What we hear enterprise leaders saying

### "We bought the AI platform. Now what?"

The tools are in place but the data inputs are a mess. Clean data was always the assumption, never
the plan.

### "We've talked to five vendors. Everyone sounds the same."

AI. Automation. Intelligent. Every company promises transformation. Almost none can show you the
path.

### "Our documents are everywhere and in every format."

PDFs, scanned images, emails, handwritten forms — siloed across systems no one wants to touch.

# MotoInk

Motorcycles originated in 1996 out of a garage in Melbourne’s northern suburbs. Since then,  the
company has grown into a powerhouse of innovation from sports bikes to bobbers and cafe racers.
Always growing with trends, we make sure to be cutting edge in our development and push extremes to
build the best bikes in Australia.
"The most important thing is to have a good relationship with the bike.. You have to understand what
she wants. I think of a motorcycle as a woman, and I know that sounds silly, but it's true."
- Valentino Rossi
TATTOO
Step into a first of its kind studio, surrounded by custom built motorcycles and the gentle buzz of
the barbers clippers, while we bring your ideas to life. Our diverse team of experienced artists
will cover your every need, from traditional Japanese to realism, we have all bases covered.
BARBER
The latest addition to MotoInk brings you a modern take on a traditional service; the Barber Shop
experience. Our value, quality, & knowledge will leave you feeling like a new man, whether it’s a
quick stop after work or a pampering before a special occasion. Combined with a wash, scalp massage,
and choice of a refreshing beverage, MotoInk Barbers offer a premium service in a first of it’s kind
environment.

MSPbots automates your entire operation, connects your whole tool stack, and gives you the

#### AI ticket triage

From 3 minutes to 3 seconds. Every ticket. Stop starting every morning with manual categorization.
MSPbots reads, classifies, and routes every incoming ticket instantly. It is trained on MSP-specific
language and works inside your existing PSA from day one.

AI Ticket QA automatically reviews every ticket against MSP industry best practices, helping you
measure service quality at scale. It identifies strengths, uncovers improvement opportunities, and
shows where your team stands on the path to operational maturity.

[Learn more][29]

The right ticket to the right tech. Automatically. End ticket cherry-picking and queue politics for
good. MSPbots routes every ticket based on skill, priority, and SLA. This ensures your dispatcher
focuses on judgment calls rather than day-to-day queue management.

[Learn more][30]

#### Sentiment analysis

Consistent service quality. Without the manual review. Catch issues before clients do. MSPbots
reviews ticket handling, flags gaps in resolution quality, and sends coaching nudges automatically —
so your standards stay high across every tech, every shift.

[Learn more][31]

#### Business intelligence

See it. Act on it. Automatically. One real-time dashboard pulling KPIs from 80+ integrations — SLA
tracking, technician utilization, ticket aging, and more. And when the numbers go off track,
automated bots fire instantly.
‍

[Learn more][32]

fundamental questions of incident management:

When manual processes slip, techs spin their wheels, budgets bleed on unused licenses, and clients
lose patience.

Rewst flips the equation. Built for the way MSPs operate, it combines native multi-tenancy, a
library of integrations and ready-to-use automations that we maintain for you, and RoboRewsty, an
in-platform AI assistant that guides you every step of the way.

The result: less busywork, faster ROI, more accurate workflows, and room to grow by increasing team
capacity. Employees get more breathing room to focus on higher-value work, which leads to faster
response times, fewer errors, and better service for clients.
